summary: A space exploration game built into the SLOOP groovebox: two knobs fly a ship over 3D planets, with landing, mining, combat, races and warps, while the rest of the FM-1 plays the music as in SLOOP.
features: Fly, land, walk, mine and fight sentinels on generated planets
Races, pursuits and a galactic warp map
Game controls on holds and double taps; quick presses work as in SLOOP
Merged SLOOP features: 15 arp modes, MIDI clock out, sections A-D
WAVE sample editor page; sounds shown as a CD carousel
Frames can still drop; flash nearly full, some samples at lower rates
